name: Ortur Laser Master H10 40W
tagline: Unofficial 40W pairing on the H10 frame: Ortur sells this machine with 10W or 20W only
tldr: Ortur does not sell an H10 40W: its H10 page offers 10W and 20W modules only, and the separate LU3-40A 40W module is listed for the LM3 and F10, not the H10. This profile covers listings that pair the H10 frame with a 40W module. Treat it as an unofficial configuration and get the seller to confirm compatibility and warranty in writing.
mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line: engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

priceRange.note: Unofficial configuration: Ortur does not list an H10 40W (Oct 2026), so these are reseller prices

cons: Ortur's H10 page does not list a 40W module: confirm compatibility and warranty with the seller

beginnerNotes: This profile covers an unofficial 40W configuration: Ortur sells the H10 with 10W or 20W modules only. Read the FAQ below, then compare the official 10W and 20W profiles via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.

editorialDepth.advantages: Ortur Laser Master H10 40W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks: fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame: safety and smoke are on you.

faq.question: Does Ortur actually sell an H10 40W?
faq.answer: Not as a listed configuration: Ortur's H10 page offers only 10W and 20W modules, and its compatibility list does not include the separate LU3-40A 40W module. A listing sold as an H10 40W is likely a reseller pairing; ask the seller to confirm the module and that it is supported on the H10 frame before buying.

faq.question: What would a 40W module cut on this frame?
faq.answer: In our benchmark profile a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 6–10 min at 4–12 mm/s. Basswood up to about 10 mm and dark acrylic up to about 5 mm are realistic in several passes with air assist. Clear acrylic stays out of reach.

faq.question: 40W or the supported 20W H10?
faq.answer: On our tracked listings the 40W costs $649–899 against $499–699 for the 20W. It is only worth it if you cut 6 mm and more every day. The 20W comes with a free air pump from Ortur and is the officially supported configuration, which matters for warranty and spare parts.

standoutFeatures.title: Fastest H10 cutting
standoutFeatures.body: 3 mm basswood squares in about 6–10 min in our benchmark profile, with cut speeds up to ~12 mm/s.

standoutFeatures.title: Quick fills
standoutFeatures.body: Roughly 80–180 mm/s on photo and logo fills, the fastest of the H10 profiles on this site.
